name: Wikkawak (Bugbear Variant)
body:
These albino bugbears have thick white fur and pupil-less white eyes. They are natives of cold climates, where they stalk glacial mountains and frozen tundra. They tend to be even more solitary and miserably cruel than most bugbears, and terrorize any remote arctic village they come across.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Dex, –2 Cha. This alters ability scores.
Hatred of Fire You gain cold resistance 5 and can use quench once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level. This trait replaces skilled.
Thuggery Intimidate and Perception are always class skills for you. This trait replaces stalker.
Weapon Familiarity You are proficient with the battleaxe, javelin, and spear. This trait alters weapon familiarity.
Alternate Species Traits
Bugaboo You can use the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—darkness, ghost sound, and vanish. You use your character level as the caster level and your highest mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) as your casting statistic. This trait replaces skilled.
Fey Heritage Like many of their goblinoid kin, some bugbears made a bargain with the lords of the fey long ago that they are still paying for to this day. These bugbears can be noted by their oddly elongated faces and twisted smiles. They also frequently have unusual coloration for bugbears, such as a strong greenish tint or glowing yellow eyes. Your type is fey instead of humanoid; you retain the goblinoid subtype. You have low-light vision. This alters your type and replaces natural armor.
Long-Limbed You gain Lunge as a bonus feat. This trait replaces natural armor.
Favored Class Bonuses
Antipaladin Adds +1/4 to the number of cruelties you can inflict.
Barbarian Add +1 to your total number of rage rounds per day.
Druid Add a +1/2 bonus on concentration checks. This bonus doubles in a forest or underground terrain.
Fighter Add +1/2 to damage rolls you make with weapon attacks against an opponent that has the shaken condition.
Ranger Choose a weapon from the following list: battleaxe, falchion, javelin, morningstar, scimitar, or spear. Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that weapon (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Rogue Add a +1/2 bonus on Perception checks while in a forest or underground.

Awesome Ancestries: 9 New Fantasy Species. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
